title: Tableau update circuits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes. The tableau update circuits are a list of $B+1$ Boolean circuits, where $B$ is the number of bits used to encode a snapshot. Each circuit has input arity $B+3+k(B+1)+1$; the circuit at index $j$ outputs bit $j$ of the one-step tableau update applied to the Boolean input vector.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
